tools.name: get-quickstart-guide
tools.description:
Get setup instructions and trial-license information for a new JxBrowser project.
Infer the toolkit and build tool from the project or conversation; ask only when unresolved.
Compose Desktop requires Gradle. This tool returns instructions; it does not create files or run commands.

tools.name: ask-jxbrowser-question
tools.description:
Get documentation-based help with JxBrowser APIs, examples, integration, and troubleshooting.
Ask one focused question when JxBrowser-specific information is needed. Each call is independent.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
